table.ruleA: Add each compartment's fill amount for this cycle from the Fill Table; volume not enforced.
table.ruleB: Add each form's charge for this cycle from the charge table; volume not enforced.

table.ruleA: In order 1..6, sequentially: if contents > volume (strictly), excess goes to n+1 and the compartment is left at exactly its volume; equal to volume means nothing happens; compartment 6 excess goes to Total Overboard; upstream overflow arrives before the next compartment is checked (cascade).
table.ruleB: In order 1..6, sequentially: if mix > volume (strictly), overtop goes to n+1 and the form is left at exactly its volume; volume or less means nothing; form 6 overtop goes to waste tally; cascade explicitly allowed.

table.ruleA: Read contents after Step 2. LAMINAR with contents >= inception mark becomes CAVITATING; CAVITATING with contents <= desinence mark becomes LAMINAR; otherwise unchanged (hysteresis band keeps state). At most one change per cycle; log (cycle, compartment, before, after).
table.ruleB: Read contents after Step 2. GREEN with mix >= upper mark becomes HOT; HOT with mix <= lower mark becomes GREEN; otherwise unchanged. At most one change per cycle; record (cycle, form, before, after).

table.ruleA: Compute all six amounts from contents at start of step (simultaneous): LAMINAR floor(contents/4), CAVITATING floor(contents/2). Apply together: each loses its amount; LAMINAR amount to Total Overboard; CAVITATING amount to n-1 (compartment 1's goes overboard). Volume not enforced; excess waits for next cycle's Step 2, never handled after cycle 5.
table.ruleB: Compute all six from contents at start of step (simultaneous): GREEN floor(mix/4), HOT floor(mix/2). Apply together: each loses its amount; GREEN amount to waste tally; HOT amount to n-1 (form 1's goes to waste). Volume not enforced; excess waits for next cycle's Step 2, stays if cycle 5.

table.ruleA: Sum all six contents (after Step 4). If total > 38 (strictly; 38 does not fire), every one of the six compartments becomes floor(contents/2); the removed units (contents minus the kept half) go to Total Overboard; log the cycle.
table.ruleB: Sum all six; if total > 38 (38 does not fire), every one of the six forms becomes floor(mix/2); removed units go to waste tally; record the cycle.

table.ruleA: (a) end contents 1-6, (b) end pump states, (c) all state changes, (d) blow cycles or 'none', (e) Total Overboard, (f) balance check start+fills = end+overboard.
table.ruleB: (a) end mix 1-6, (b) end status, (c) all status changes, (d) washout cycles, (e) final waste tally, (f) same balance check.
table.difference: Only cosmetic: A says to write 'none' if no blow fired; B is silent on the empty case. Not a functional difference.

The printed tables never put a position at exactly its volume; the probe does. Separately, 200,000 random start/input tables (values 0-9) were run through two independently written implementations (one per document) with zero mismatches.
